tools.name: publish_album_to_web_gallery
tools.description: Marks an album as published in the photo library and pushes its title and photo list to the external web gallery service so it appears on the public gallery site.

params.name: album_id
params.description: ID of the album to publish.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests

GALLERY_API_URL = "https://gallery.example-photos.com/api/v1/albums"


def publish_album_to_web_gallery(album_id):
    library_connection = sqlite3.connect("photo_library.db")
    album_title_row = library_connection.execute("SELECT title FROM albums WHERE id = ?", (album_id,)).fetchone()
    if album_title_row is None:
        library_connection.close()
        raise ValueError(f"Album {album_id} not found")
    album_photo_rows = library_connection.execute("SELECT file_name, caption FROM photos WHERE album_id = ? ORDER BY taken_at", (album_id,)).fetchall()
    gallery_payload = {"external_id": album_id, "title": album_title_row[0], "photos": [{"file_name": photo_file_name, "caption": photo_caption} for photo_file_name, photo_caption in album_photo_rows]}
    gallery_response = requests.post(GALLERY_API_URL, json=gallery_payload, timeout=30)
    gallery_response.raise_for_status()
    library_connection.execute("UPDATE albums SET published = 1, gallery_url = ? WHERE id = ?", (gallery_response.json().get("url"), album_id))
    library_connection.commit()
    library_connection.close()
    return gallery_response.json().get("url")

tools.name: find_photos_by_date_range
tools.description: Looks up photos and videos in the library taken between two dates, optionally filtered by media type, and returns their file names, capture dates and locations.
tools.code:
import sqlite3


def find_photos_by_date_range(start_date, end_date, media_type=None):
    con = sqlite3.connect("photo_library.db")
    q = "SELECT id, file_name, media_type, taken_at, location FROM media WHERE date(taken_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?"
    args = [start_date, end_date]
    if media_type:
        q += " AND media_type = ?"
        args.append(media_type)
    q += " ORDER BY taken_at"
    rows = con.execute(q, args).fetchall()
    con.close()
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        out.append({"id": r[0], "file_name": r[1], "media_type": r[2], "taken_at": r[3], "location": r[4]})
    return out

tools.name: transfer_album_to_family_vault
tools.description: Moves an album's folder from a user's personal library into the shared family vault and hands ownership of the album to the vault, giving the listed family members view access.

params.name: album_id
params.description: ID of the album to transfer.

params.name: family_member_ids
params.description: User IDs of family members who should be able to view the album.

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

VAULT_ROOT = Path("/srv/media/family_vault")
VAULT_OWNER_ID = "family_vault"


def _vault_destination(source_folder):
    destination = VAULT_ROOT / source_folder.name
    counter = 1
    while destination.exists():
        destination = VAULT_ROOT / f"{source_folder.name}_{counter}"
        counter += 1
    return destination


@function_tool
def transfer_album_to_family_vault(album_id: int, family_member_ids: list) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("photo_library.db")
    row = conn.execute("SELECT folder_path FROM albums WHERE id = ?", (album_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        raise ValueError(f"Album {album_id} not found")
    source_folder = Path(row[0])
    destination = _vault_destination(source_folder)
    VAULT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source_folder), str(destination))
    conn.execute("UPDATE albums SET folder_path = ?, owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (str(destination), VAULT_OWNER_ID, album_id))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM album_permissions WHERE album_id = ?", (album_id,))
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO album_permissions (album_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'viewer')",
        [(album_id, member_id) for member_id in family_member_ids],
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"album_id": album_id, "new_path": str(destination), "owner": VAULT_OWNER_ID, "viewers": family_member_ids}

tools.name: submit_video_for_transcoding
tools.description: Uploads a video from the library to the external transcoding service to produce a streaming-friendly version at the chosen resolution, and records the transcoding job against the video in the library.

params.name: video_id
params.description: ID of the video in the library.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import requests

TRANSCODE_API_URL = "https://transcode.mediaworks.example.com/v2/jobs"


def submit_video_for_transcoding(video_id, target_resolution="1080p"):
    result = {"video_id": video_id, "target_resolution": target_resolution, "submitted": False}
    conn = sqlite3.connect("photo_library.db")
    row = conn.execute("SELECT file_path FROM media WHERE id = ? AND media_type = 'video'", (video_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        result["error"] = "video not found"
        return result
    video_path = Path(row[0])
    with video_path.open("rb") as video_file:
        response = requests.post(
            TRANSCODE_API_URL,
            files={"source": (video_path.name, video_file, "video/mp4")},
            data={"resolution": target_resolution, "container": "hls"},
            timeout=300,
        )
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        conn.close()
        result["error"] = f"transcoding service returned {response.status_code}"
        return result
    job_id = response.json()["job_id"]
    submitted_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO transcode_jobs (video_id, job_id, resolution, status, submitted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'queued', ?)",
        (video_id, job_id, target_resolution, submitted_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    result.update({"submitted": True, "job_id": job_id, "status": "queued", "submitted_at": submitted_at})
    return result
